title: Maintenance Administrator
description:
Job Title: Maintenance Administrator

Location: Poole, Dorset - Office based

Salary: Circa 26,800 - 29,950 per annum, depending on experience

Job Type: Permanent, Full time

Working Hours: 40 hours per week, 08:30 to 17:30 Monday to Friday

About Us:

Established in 1988, Vent Group is a leading provider of natural and smoke ventilation systems to business and local authority customers throughout the UK.

Well known for innovation, customer commitment, reliability and value, our success is built on a practical straight forward approach. We take complex problems and make them simple.

We believe business is all about people. Our team work hard building strong relationships with our customers to help achieve their ventilation project goals.

The Role:

Vent Engineering is seeking an experienced administrator to work in our maintenance team at our offices in Poole.

Working alongside the Maintenance Administration Manager, you will provide high-quality support and administrative help with the day-to-day administration of the maintenance department.

The successful candidate will be flexible, willing to learn and comfortable working individually or as part of a supportive busy team in a face-to-face environment.

Key responsibilities:

Key duties will include but not be limited to the following:
- Preparing and issuing contract quotations to clients, along with company information
- Preparing pro-forma invoices and prepare and update sales orders
- Use bespoke software to record all site history and communications accurately
- Handling incoming calls and emails
- Process client payments alongside the accounts department
- Record & label engineers job sheets and photos
- Quote preparation for remedial works
- Scheduling appointments for our engineers for current contracts and emergency call outs, including job pack preparation
- Preparing customer facing reports from engineer's job sheets
- Booking travel and hotels as required
- Managing 'Van Stock' and returns as required
- Supporting the wider maintenance team with day-to-day administrative tasks

About you:

To be successful for this role, the following is required:
- Previous experience in a fast-paced office role (minimum 2 years office experience)
- Strong communication skills as there will be lots of liaising with colleagues across the business as well as with clients on the telephone and via emails
- Excellent numeracy and IT skills including Microsoft Office.
- Organised, very accurate with a high attention to detail with both financials and contracts
- Ability to follow procedures accurately
- Ability to prioritise own workload and be able to use your initiative and work effectively under pressure.

Desirable:
- Experience within maintenance, engineering, facilities, construction or service-based environments would be advantageous

Benefits:
- 23 days paid holiday plus bank holidays, which increases with length of service
- A contributory pension scheme
- Enhanced sick pay after 12 months service
- Free on-site parking
- Private medical insurance (currently Bupa) after 12 months service
- Free gym membership at a local gym
- Cycle to work scheme
- Free eye tests
- Free confidential counselling helpline

Please click the APPLY button to submit your CV for this role.

Candidates with experience or relevant job titles of: Maintenance Admin, Office Administrator, Admin Assistant, Business Administrator, Facility Operations Coordinator, Property Maintenance Administrator, Construction Administrator, Service Administrator, Booking Coordinator, Maintenance Coordinator, may also be considered.

title: Service Administrator
company: Wallace Hind Selection LTD - Agency - Permanent
salary_text: £32000 - £35000 per year (25 Days Holiday (pro rata) + Pension)
description:
Are you an experienced Service Administrator or Service Coordinator looking for a part-time role with some flexibility around your hours? Based in Poole, you'll support a busy engineering service team, keeping service jobs, purchase orders and spare parts records up to date. The role is typically 20 hours a week, with a regular working pattern agreed with you.

BASIC SALARY: Circa £32,000 - £35,000 FTE

BENEFITS:
25 days annual leave (pro rata based on the agreed working hours)
Company pension
Employee Assistance Programme

LOCATION: Poole

This is a permanent, part-time role, typically 20 hours per week. You'll be based at the Poole site, with some remote working possible by agreement.

COMMUTABLE LOCATIONS: Bournemouth, Poole, Christchurch, Wimborne Minster, Ferndown, Broadstone, Wareham, Ringwood, Swanage.

JOB DESCRIPTION: Service Administrator, Service Coordinator, Operations Administrator - Engineering Services, Equipment Servicing, Spare Parts

As our Service Administrator, you'll take ownership of the day-to-day administration and document control that supports equipment servicing, repairs, spare parts and related projects. You'll work closely with Engineers, project teams and Finance to keep records accurate, check invoice progress and resolve stock discrepancies. You'll also help coordinate the Poole facility and improve how the team manages stock and administration as the operation grows.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: Service Administrator, Service Coordinator, Operations Administrator - Engineering Services, Equipment Servicing, Spare Parts

Maintain customer, supplier and project records in IFS, prepare operational reports and keep service and project documentation up to date.
Check and track invoicing with project and finance colleagues, support day-to-day system queries and help with the move to IFS Cloud.
Maintain stock records for spare parts, consumables and project components. Assist with stocktakes, investigate discrepancies and help order replacement stock.
Support import and export paperwork for equipment, spare parts and materials.
Coordinate day-to-day facilities administration, including maintenance, utilities, site services and consumables.
Support planning and procurement and help improve stock controls and administrative processes.

PERSON SPECIFICATION: Service Administrator, Service Coordinator, Operations Administrator - Engineering Services, Equipment Servicing, Spare Parts

You will have a methodical approach to record keeping, with the ability to manage competing deadlines, handle confidential information and know when to escalate an issue.

You will also have:

Experience with purchase orders, service job administration, planning and general administration.
Good working knowledge of Excel, Outlook and an ERP or accounting system. Experience with IFS would be an advantage.
Confidence handling customer account information and dealing professionally with customers, suppliers and colleagues across operations and Finance.
A background in engineering, manufacturing, equipment servicing, maintenance or spare parts would be beneficial. Knowledge of stock control or import and export administration would also be an advantage.

THE COMPANY:

We're an engineering business that supplies and supports equipment for industrial and infrastructure customers. Our Poole team works with colleagues across the business to deliver equipment servicing, repairs and spare parts.

It is highly likely you will have worked in any of the following roles and/or markets, and worked with the following products and/or services: Service Administrator, Service Coordinator, Engineering Administrator, Operations Administrator, Service Support Administrator, Parts Administrator, Stock Administrator, Technical Administrator, Engineering Services, Equipment Servicing, Manufacturing, Maintenance and Repairs, Spare Parts, Stock Control, ERP, IFS, Import and Export Administration.

title: Supply Chain Administrator
description:
Supply Chain Administrator

Poole 30,000- 33,000 per annum Permanent
40 hours per week Office-based

TeamJobs is recruiting a Supply Chain Administrator to join our client's busy team in Poole.

This is a great opportunity for someone with experience in supply chain, purchasing or logistics who enjoys working with data, coordinating deliveries and building strong supplier relationships. You'll help keep day-to-day operations running smoothly, ensuring stock is available to meet business demand.

The role:
- Raise and manage purchase orders, track outstanding orders and follow up with suppliers.
- Run daily MRP processes to identify purchasing requirements.
- Monitor stock levels, forecast demand and support replenishment planning.
- Maintain supplier relationships, monitor performance and resolve delivery issues.
- Coordinate inbound shipments, import documentation and deliveries to third-party warehouses.
- Maintain accurate product, supplier and inventory records.
- Produce reports and analyse data to identify trends and opportunities for improvement.
- Work closely with sales, warehouse, finance and logistics teams to communicate updates and resolve stock issues.

About you:
- Previous experience in supply chain, purchasing, logistics, inventory planning or distribution.
- Experience using ERP, MRP or warehouse management systems.
- Strong Excel skills, including Pivot Tables and VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP.
- Excellent attention to detail and a confident approach to analysing data.
- Strong communication, organisation and problem-solving skills.
- A proactive attitude and the ability to manage multiple priorities.

Experience with international suppliers, import processes or third-party logistics would be beneficial.

Benefits include:
- Monthly profit share bonus scheme.
- 30 days' paid holiday, including bank holidays.
- Modern, open-plan office with free onsite parking.
- Free lunch every Friday.
- Company sick pay and an employee assistance programme.
- Perks at Work and Cycle to Work schemes.
- Birthday vouchers, eye care reimbursement and subsidised workplace massage.
- Company social and corporate events.

Apply today with TeamJobs to take the next step in your supply chain career!

title: ESR Administrator
company: Dorset HealthCare University NHS Foundation Trust
advertiser_name: Dorset HealthCare University NHS Foundation Trust
description: We are looking for a proactive and highly motivated ESR Administrator to join our team during an exciting period of growth, innovation and preparation for the future workforce solution. We are dedicated to enhancing and expanding the ESR system and services we provide to all staff at Dorset HealthCare University Foundation Trust. As the primary workforce management system used across the NHS, ESR plays a pivotal role in our operations. By joining our team, you will contribute to driving positive change within the trust, helping us deliver improved services and support to all employees. The ideal candidate will have previous experience with ESR. As an ESR Administrator you will provide essential support to our staff by managing access and training needs via the service desk, maintaining, reporting, and reviewing accounts, roles, work structure's and data quality within ESR. Interviews will be held 21st and 22nd of December. A minimum of 2 days in the office will be required. Please note visa sponsorship for this role is unfortunately not available. Ensure you hold valid right to work in the UK and will not require sponsorship if successful. You will play a key role in delivering and maintaining Manager, Administrator, Supervisor and Employee Self-Service. Optimising existing system functionalities, and implementing new features and functionality across various departments and teams. The role of ESR Administrator will include providing training needs and ongoing support to all staff and their use of Self-Service, and working cooperatively and maintaining close working relationships with our other trusts departments, particularly HR, Payroll, Finance and Rostering. It is essential that you have excellent IT Skills, including Microsoft Office, Teams and Outlook. Previous experience of ESR and Self-Service is desirable but not essential as full training will be provided. You must be methodical, organised, and work to a high standard with a flexible approach and understanding of the need to respond/deliver work across a diverse area within tight timescales. The role is based at our Dorset HealthCare HQ site in Poole and a weekly presence is required on site. There may also be the need for occasional travel to our other sites around Dorset. The post holder may be required to work flexibly to meet the needs of the service. For the main duties and responsibilities for this role please read the attached job description and person specification. When completing your application please ensure your supporting statement reflects the criteria set out in these documents by showing how your experience and skills apply to this post. We understand that AI can be a useful tool when completing your application. However, we are seeing an increasing over-reliance of AI tools, which can negatively affect your application as it reduces a candidates individuality, and makes it difficult for us to gain a clear and authentic understanding of your experience, skills, and in turn your suitability for the role. All submissions must be truthful and if you do use AI, it should only be used to enhance your application and not create your supporting statement in its entirety. Your supporting statement should be in your own words and must accurately reflect your personal experience and achievements. Where we have concerns that AI has been used to generate content that misrepresents your experience and suitability for the role, we may withdraw your application. As part of our vision to have a skilled, diverse and caring workforce, Dorset HealthCare offers support for people getting into work. We offer an employability service to support individuals with application writing, interview skills and other employment support. If you would like or know of anyone who would value this support, please do contact dhc.wideningparticipation@nhs.net
